name: lipid_unconditional_cnof_v1_smoke
purpose: Exploratory restricted-ring LIPID smoke (authorized now per exec-plan lipid-transition gate; full training gated behind Paper-1 P1-G7). Validates the Lineage-B base (hierarchical/flat/boolean/flexible_size_graft/carbon_tree/sequential/factorized_marks -- clean edit dynamics, beat pancake 33% vs 17%, no self-events/collapse) at LIPID scale (max_atoms=96 vs drug-like 40) on the CNOF-generatable lipid corpus. Base config inherited from Lineage B (Modal compose-v4-stage3-flexible-graft-3k-1ac6f19-v1/checkpoint.best_so_far.pt, SHA c9d9275103...); WEIGHTS trained fresh (B is drug-like C/N/O/F). Corpus = generator_corpus_cnof_v1.smiles (429,335 unique CNOF-clean lipids, R0 anchor + R1 support, <=96 heavy, neutral) passed as the positional smiles_file / launcher train_file. Rings: flat + corpus-derived typed catalog auto-restricts to the observed single 5/6 head rings (lipids ~0.6 rings/mol) -- topology_cycle_hierarchical deliberately OFF (drug-like fusion machinery). Verify at rollout: mean size ~lipid scale, and that clean-dynamics B qualifies WITHOUT the pancake calibration band-aids (atom_delete -0.5 kept only as a size start; small_ring -1.5 not needed). S/P families (~7.6%) deferred to a CNOSP kernel extension with Codex. Smoke sizes/steps below are small to validate the pipeline + tune memory at 96 atoms; scale train_size/steps up for the real run.
